name: R3-T2
description: R3-T2, or just R3, was an R3-series astromech droid with red, blue, and white paneling. They lived in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine and in 9 BBY stood in one of the streets when a transport carrying three Inquisitors landed nearby. In 1 BBY, the droid passed by a X-34 landspeeder as they moved along Corporations Road in the spaceport.
